name: Div
description: A class of demons of Iranian and broader Persianate mythology, descended from the Avestan daēvas demonised under Zoroastrianism. Most famous as the divs of Ferdowsi's Shāhnāmeh — gigantic, horned, monstrous beings, including Div-e Sefid (the White Div) and Akvan Div — who oppose the hero Rostam.

aliases.name: Div-e Sefīd
aliases.meaning: White Div, antagonist of the hero Rostam

origin: The Iranian and Persianate cultural sphere, including Iran, Tajikistan, Afghanistan, the Kurdish-speaking areas of Iraq and Turkey, the South Caucasus, and parts of South Asia influenced by Persian literary culture.
